**Task J3: Add visual paragraph chunking to renderText()**

In `chat.js`, in the `renderText()` function, find the paragraph loop where `p` elements are created. After the line that creates the paragraph element and before it's appended to the fragment, add a class for long paragraphs:

Find this pattern in renderText():
```javascript
const p = document.createElement("p");
_appendInlineMarkup(p, trimmed);
frag.appendChild(p);
```

Change it to:
```javascript
const p = document.createElement("p");
_appendInlineMarkup(p, trimmed);
if (trimmed.length > 200) {
  p.classList.add("sd-para-long");
}
frag.appendChild(p);
```

This enables CSS to add extra margin to long paragraphs for better scanability.

**Task J4: Add aria-labels for accessibility**

In `sidebar.js`, in the `buildSidebar()` function, find the HTML template string and update:

1. The messages div — add `role="log"`, `aria-live="polite"`, and `aria-label`:
```html
<div class="sd-messages" id="sd-messages" role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Chat with Super Duper AI">
```

2. The send button — add `aria-label`:
```html
<button id="sd-send" class="sd-send-btn" aria-label="Send message">Send</button>
```

Make ALL changes.
